title: DepositFieldTable
description: Shape of a star system's deposit file, data/world/deposits/{star_system_id}.json (p1-02). SERVER-SIDE TRUTH FOR mineral_id AND initial_reserve_kg: a client may hold a copy of this file (ADR-0012 section 7 file copy) but must read only id, display_name, position_m and radius_m from it; the mineral of a deposit reaches the client only through DEPOSIT_FIELD_STATE after the deposit is revealed. Boot-time checks beyond this schema (all boot failures, spec p1-02 I-38 extension): every mineral_id exists in data/minerals; every mineral has at least one deposit; star_system_id equals a loaded star system; |position| + radius_m + mining_range_from_surface_m <= soft_boundary_radius_m; regen_kg <= initial_reserve_kg; ids unique; mining zones of two deposits do not overlap. Positions are system-local metres (ADR-0009 section 1). 단위 접미사 규약: 수치 필드 이름이 단위로 끝난다 (_m, _mps, _s, _kg). **_kg 필드는 정수다** — 수량은 경제 값이므로 ADR-0009 section 2 의 SI 실수 예외에 들지 않는다(primitives MassKg). _s 필드도 정수이고 tick_hz 를 곱해 정수 tick 이 되어야 한다(서버 기동 검증).

display_name.description: Region-only name; must not reveal the mineral.
